These files come from the GovDocs1 corpus (https://digitalcorpora.org/corpora/file-corpora/files/), which was
crawled from public web servers in 2009. Only files whose original URL is on a United States federal
government site are included; works of the US federal government are not subject to copyright in the US
(17 U.S.C. 105). `../MANIFEST.csv` gives the original URL, SHA-1 and SHA-256 of each file. The files are
unmodified. Names are the corpus's document ids.
